assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE production-ready raster game UI frame asset for a Japanese sweets-themed arcade bingo payout table called Dango de Bingo. Landscape rectangular panel approximately 3:2 aspect ratio. Wide perfectly flat solid black central field occupying at least 88% width and 84% height; this must stay empty black so live numerical payouts are legible. Decorate ONLY the narrow outer border with glossy 3D Japanese three-color dango dumplings (pink, ivory, matcha green), fine honey-gold trim and small bamboo skewer accents in corners. Playful polished confectionery arcade game artwork, highly crafted, elegant compact detail. Straight-on front view, symmetric frame, clean rectangle. Outer border within outer 4-5% on each side. Entire image is rectangular, black background including interior. No lettering, no numbers, no title, no payout data, no grid, no characters, no checkerboard, no SVG. Keep the black center genuinely blank. The panel must work when overlaid by a compact real HTML table.
